fix_ideas: baseq3 menu, the real fix for both engines and on the pure server: compile ioq3's q3_ui, which reads r_availableModes and keeps r_mode -1 and custom sizes, into a ui.qvm. Ship it in a pk3 that sorts after pak8 (e.g. baseq3/zz-fleet-ui.pk3) in the staged tree AND in quake3-server's baseq3 so sv_pure accepts it. Must be verified on hardware: that retail 1.32c runs that QVM, and that both clients still join the pure server.

A cheaper, partial option for baseq3: seta vm_ui "0" for the ioquake3 launcher only. Measured: the main-menu Video Mode then lists and keeps 1920x1080. But the pure fleet server forces the QVM back in game, so it does not help there. Do not put it in the shared autoexec.cfg, which retail 1.32c also execs; retail cannot use the ioq3 uix86.dll (untested, risky). Alternatively run quake3-server with sv_pure 0, which is a trade-off.

Team Arena menu: override ui/system.menu and ui/ingame_system.menu in a missionpack pk3 on both the client and q3ta-server, adding an r_mode -1 entry (e.g. 'Fleet custom' -1) to the Video Mode cvarFloatList so it shows and keeps the launcher's size. The Quality presets hard-code r_mode 3 or 4 in the QVM, so removing that needs a rebuilt TA UI (ioq3 missionpack source).

Keep and document the launcher self-heal: fleetres.cfg exec'd last plus the command-line +set, which measurably wins in ioq3 1.36. Record in provisioning/fleetres/PER-TITLE-STATUS.md that the in-game Video Mode menus (baseq3 and TA) cannot express 1920x1080 and must not be ACCEPTed.

Team Arena favourites: add a missionpack title to scripts/gameindex/favorites.py with accepts={'missionpack'}. First verify on hardware, with the mouse or a person at the box, whether TA's browser uses server1..16 or only the engine's servercache.dat. If only servercache.dat, write that binary store (a 12-byte header plus the serverInfo_t arrays) rather than cvars.

Favourites job: make the BUSY guard check the target path, skipping a file if any exe that shares it is running, and log per path. Consider rewriting only when the set of servers changes, not their order. Consider filtering internet servers whose gamename differs from the title's (excessiveplus, freon, ...) out of baseq3 favourites.
Remove the stale deployed files ('Play Quake III Arena (retail 1.32c).bat', baseq3\lan.cfg, botlib.log) with a one-off purge or a deletion in the title's launcher, then push to every box.
